0022600136.text: The Raptors (2-1, 1-0 at home) host the Orlando Magic (1-2, 0-2 at home) in their fourth game of the season, with Toronto third in the Atlantic, half a game back, and fifth in the East, while Orlando sits 10th in the East after winning its last game on the road. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Kawhi Leonard is day-to-day with knee inflammation and a game-time decision, averaging 19.5 points and 25.8 minutes per game this season. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (out, ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (out, knee), Jonathan Isaac (out, knee), Noah Penda (out, hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (out, ankle sprain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and beat Orlando 139-87 in Toronto in their last meeting.
